<function name="LoadTGAImage" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>
<deprecated><page>DImage</page> should be used instead (with `.png` or `.jpg` images). `TGAImage` panel has no advantages.</deprecated>

Sets a new image to be loaded by a <page>TGAImage</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="imageName" type="string">The file path.</arg>
		<arg name="strPath" type="string">The PATH to search in. See <page>File Search Paths</page>.

This isn't used internally.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
